summary: OBOOK Holdings Inc. (OwlTing Group, NASDAQ: OWLS) filed a Form 6-K with a press release announcing July 2026 operating metrics for its OwlPay Harbor platform: payment volume up 107.6% month-over-month, transaction count up 109.5%, sixth consecutive monthly increase, and enterprise clients at 79 versus 67 in June. It also describes the platform's cross-border digital currency payment services, settlement into 40+ countries, and participation in the Circle Payments Network. This is routine operational disclosure with no special-situation corporate event, transaction, or strategic action; therefore, it is not classified as a special situation.
